title: Unvalidated strategies traded without leaderboard check
description: Strategies ma_crossover_20_optimized and rsi_14_30_70_optimized were used in live trading but do not exist in strategy_leaderboard.json. They were never backtested, never validated, and caused losses.
root_cause: Pipeline does not read strategy_leaderboard.json before approving trades. Pipeline uses strategy names that bypass the leaderboard entirely.

title: Watchdog built but never deployed — 3 failures
description: CEOReportingReliabilityWatchdog class was built, tested manually, but never started as persistent process. Reports were generated only during manual tests, not autonomously. This happened 3 times: morning cron invisible, afternoon manual test only, evening no process running.
root_cause: Habit of building code without deploying it. No deployment verification step. No process health check.
previous_fix: Built service file but did not start it

title: Reports generated but not delivered to CEO
description: Reports were saved to local files but CEO could not see them. Delivery.mode was 'none' for cron jobs. No push notification. No external channel. CEO had to manually ask for reports.
root_cause: No delivery confirmation mechanism. No external notification channels configured. Assumption that file generation equals delivery.

title: Local state disagreed with Alpaca broker state
description: Local position_monitor_state.json showed ETHUSD position open (0.2346 qty) while Alpaca API showed 0 positions. Stale state persisted for hours. Position monitor did not detect mismatch.
root_cause: Position monitor treats local state as source of truth. No broker verification step. Empty position list from Alpaca does not clear local state.

title: Partial-sell death spiral and dust positions
description: Partial sell flag was not set after successful partial sell, causing repeated sell attempts. Dust quantities (qty < 0.00001) triggered sell orders that failed, wasting fees and confusing state.
root_cause: partial_sold flag not atomically set. No minimum quantity guard. No idempotency check for exit actions.

title: Self-evolution failed — reactive only, not proactive
description: Every critical fix was initiated AFTER CEO pointed out the failure. No issue was detected autonomously. Memory files exist but are not operationalized into automated checks. Lessons written but not enforced.
root_cause: No automated pre-cycle self-check. No health monitoring that triggers fixes. No enforcement layer for memory lessons.

description: RSI Range Trading strategy backtested on 6 months of BTC/ETH/SOL hourly data. Failed all metrics: 1 trade per asset, 0% win rate, -3% to -5% return, negative Sharpe. Strategy fundamentally unsuited for crypto hourly trading.
root_cause: Strategy designed for ranging markets with clear S/R. Crypto hourly is trending, not ranging. RSI < 30 rare in uptrend. 24h lookback too short for crypto volatility.
impact: Prevents future deployment of mean-reversion strategies without trend regime confirmation
resolution: Reject strategy. Add to leaderboard as REJECTED. Require trend regime analysis before any mean-reversion strategy deployment.
